entry.summary:
I wanted to explore the familiar things around me from a different perspective. Using everyday objects and visual elements from my surroundings as inspiration, I reinterpret and transform their forms into abstract human heads.

entry.title: CHISO - Brand Identity
entry.summary: CHISO (之初) — Botanical Skincare Brand Identity & Packaging Design CHISO is a luxury skincare brand rooted in the philosophy that "skin is memory." Bridging Eastern botanical heritage with advanced Australian cosmetic formulation, CHISO harnesses the soothing essence of the native purple Perilla leaf to restore the skin to its purest beginning. This comprehensive visual identity system and packaging design project captures an atmosphere of quiet luxury, serenity, and poetic healing. At the heart of the brand identity is a minimalist monogram logo intertwining the initials C and S, paired with the timeless editorial typography of Proxima Sera. Anchored by a muted Perilla-purple color palette, tactile sustainable packaging, and evocative art direction, the brand strategy transforms a humble Asian herb into a sophisticated, contemporary beauty and wellness experience.
entry.content:
Autor(es): LN Hung, AgenC Creative

CHISO (之初) — Botanical Skincare Brand Identity & Packaging Design CHISO is a luxury skincare brand rooted in the philosophy that "skin is memory." Bridging Eastern botanical heritage with advanced Australian cosmetic formulation, CHISO harnesses the soothing essence of the native purple Perilla leaf to restore the skin to its purest beginning. This comprehensive visual identity system and packaging design project captures an atmosphere of quiet luxury, serenity, and poetic healing. At the heart of the brand identity is a minimalist monogram logo intertwining the initials C and S, paired with the timeless editorial typography of Proxima Sera. Anchored by a muted Perilla-purple color palette, tactile sustainable packaging, and evocative art direction, the brand strategy transforms a humble Asian herb into a sophisticated, contemporary beauty and wellness experience.


About CHISO

VI:
"Chi sơ" (之初): Thuở ban sơ, lúc mọi thứ vừa mới bắt đầu.
Bạn có biết, làn da không chỉ là tấm áo choàng bảo vệ cơ thể, mà còn là một cuốn nhật ký lặng thầm? Làn da là ký ức. Nó trân trọng lưu giữ vạt ánh sáng đầu tiên, cất giấu sự thuần khiết của những năm tháng đầu đời. Rồi thời gian trôi, làn da ấy tiếp tục ôm vào lòng những mùa nắng gắt, những lần chạm khẽ, và cả những thay đổi âm thầm mà đôi khi chính ta cũng lãng quên.

Thấu hiểu hành trình ấy, CHISO ra đời. CHISO không muốn xóa bỏ ký ức của bạn, mà muốn vỗ về, chữa lành và nuôi dưỡng làn da, để nó một lần nữa được tỏa sáng rạng rỡ, bình yên và khỏe mạnh như thuở "chi sơ".

EN:
"Chi so" (之初): The very beginning, the origin of all things.
Have you ever wondered if your skin is more than just a protective veil, perhaps a silent diary of your life? Skin is memory. It tenderly holds onto that very first touch of light, preserving the purity of your earliest years. As time flows on, it continues to embrace scorching summers, gentle touches, and quiet transformations that even we sometimes forget.

Understanding this intimate journey, CHISO was born. We do not seek to erase your memories; instead, we are here to soothe, heal, and nourish your skin,allowing it to once again glow with the radiant, peaceful, and healthy vitality of its "chi so" its purest beginning.


Logo

VI:
Biểu tượng của CHISO được kiến tạo từ hai ký tự cốt lõi C và S, đại diện cho hai âm tiết "Chi Sơ". Thông qua nghệ thuật thiết kế Monogram tối giản, hai đường nét được lồng ghép uyển chuyển trên nền phông chữ Serif cổ điển, tạo nên một tổng thể vừa sang trọng, tinh tế, vừa mang tính biểu tượng vượt thời gian.

Sự giao thoa giữa C và S không chỉ đơn thuần là sự kết hợp về mặt thị giác, mà còn ẩn chứa triết lý sâu sắc của thương hiệu: đó là cái ôm dịu dàng của CHISO dành cho làn da, là sự kết nối liền mạch giữa quá khứ và hiện tại, đưa làn da trở về trạng thái nguyên bản, thuần khiết nhất như thuở ban đầu.

EN:
Crafted from the brand's two core initials, C and S, the CHISO emblem comes to life through a minimalist monogram design. Rooted in a classic serif typeface, the intertwined letters exude timeless elegance and quiet sophistication. Beyond aesthetics, this seamless fusion symbolizes the gentle embrace of CHISO, harmonizing past memories with present care to restore your skin to its purest, original state.


Color & Font

VI:
Sắc màu chủ đạo của CHISO được chắt lọc từ sắc tím trầm mặc của lá tía tô, thành phần tinh túy nhất nuôi dưỡng nên từng giọt sản phẩm. Không rực rỡ hay phô trương, sắc tím của tía tô mang trong mình vẻ đẹp mộc mạc của thảo mộc phương Đông nhưng lại ẩn chứa sự sang trọng, tĩnh tại đến lạ kỳ. Đó là sắc màu của sự vỗ về, của khả năng kháng viêm, làm dịu và chữa lành những tổn thương âm thầm, đưa làn da trở về trạng thái bình yên và thuần khiết như thuở ban đầu.

Hệ thống typography của CHISO lựa chọn Proxima Sera làm phông chữ chủ đạo, một thiết kế Serif mang vẻ đẹp giao thoa giữa nét cổ điển vượt thời gian và hơi thở đương đại. Những đường nét có chân thanh mảnh, uyển chuyển của Proxima Sera nhằm tôn vinh tính sang trọng của thương hiệu, mà còn gợi nhắc đến những trang nhật ký nhuốm màu thời gian, nơi lưu giữ từng vùng ký ức của làn da một cách trân trọng, tĩnh tại và đầy chất thơ.

EN:
CHISO’s signature color is distilled from the muted, contemplative purple of the Perilla leaf, the purest botanical essence nourishing every drop of our formulation. Neither ostentatious nor loud, this hue carries the rustic charm of Eastern botanicals while exuding a remarkably serene and quiet luxury. It is the color of gentle comfort, reflecting the leaf’s natural ability to calm inflammation, soothe, and heal silent damage, guiding the skin back to a state of peace and original purity.

For its typographic identity, CHISO selects Proxima Sera as its primary typeface, a serif design that beautifully bridges timeless classicism with a contemporary spirit. The slender, graceful serifs of Proxima Sera not only elevate the brand’s refined elegance, but also evoke the time-worn pages of an intimate journal, where every memory of the skin is cherished with reverence, stillness, and poetic grace.


Why Perilla leaf?

VI:
Điểm chạm độc bản làm nên linh hồn của CHISO nằm ở sự giao thoa kỳ diệu giữa di sản thảo mộc phương Đông và nền khoa học điều chế tiên tiến từ nước Úc. Nếu lá tía tô mang trong mình sinh khí của vùng đất Á Đông, một phương thuốc dân gian lành tính giàu hoạt chất kháng viêm, chống oxy hóa và vỗ về làn da, thì công nghệ chiết xuất chuẩn Úc chính là "chìa khóa" đánh thức trọn vẹn nguồn năng lượng ấy ở cấp độ tinh khiết nhất.

Thay vì giữ lại phương thức chắt lọc truyền thống dễ làm hao hụt dưỡng chất, quy trình điều chế khắt khe tại Úc giúp bóc tách và bảo toàn nguyên vẹn cấu trúc phân tử quý giá của lá tía tô, đồng thời loại bỏ hoàn toàn các tạp chất gây kích ứng. Sự kết hợp này biến một nhánh thảo mộc mộc mạc, quen thuộc trở thành những giọt tinh chất có khả năng thẩm thấu sâu, chữa lành những tổn thương âm thầm với hiệu quả vượt trội và độ an toàn tuyệt đối.

EN:
At the heart of CHISO’s innovation lies a harmonious convergence of Eastern botanical heritage and advanced Australian formulation science. While the Perilla leaf carries the nurturing soul of Asian traditional remedies, naturally rich in anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, it is Australia’s cutting-edge extraction technology that unlocks its fullest potential.

Subjected to Australia’s rigorous cosmetic standards, the rustic Perilla leaf is refined at a molecular level to preserve its most potent bio-actives while eliminating impurities. This East-meets-West synergy transforms a humble, time-honored Asian herb into a high-performance, deeply penetrating elixir, delivering scientific precision while honoring the gentle purity of nature.


Client: CHISO by Pristine
Scope of Work: Logo, Visual Identity System & Packaging
Art Direction: Hung Le.
Creative Designer: Hung Le.
Project Owner: Bang Chau

PERSONAL ILLUSTRATIONS 2026

A new selection of my latest personal illustrations.

Personal work has always been an essential part of my creative journey. It's where I get to explore new ideas, experiment with colors, compositions, techniques and push my visual language in new directions without the limitations of a creative brief.

Every illustration is entirely vector based, created by hand in Adobe Illustrator. Countless hours of drawing, refining, and bringing each idea to life, one shape and line at a time.

There's no particular theme connecting these pieces. Inspiration can come from anywhere and I enjoy the freedom of turning whatever sparks my imagination into something visual.

For me, personal projects are not just a creative escape from commercial work. They're an opportunity to evolve as an artist, challenge myself and discover new possibilities that often find their way into my commissioned projects.

entry.title: Lemonade Global Ventures
entry.summary: Lemonade Global Ventures is an investment fund founded by experienced entrepreneurs, focused on scaling profitable businesses with proven revenue models. Its verbal and visual identity reflects a strategic, results-driven approach, combining commercial intelligence with the real-world experience of building and scaling companies. The brand symbol merges a lemon silhouette with a globe, representing the intersection of sharp business decisions and global expansion. Concepts such as Zero Sugar and Squeeze reinforce its positioning: no empty promises or easy formulas, just strategic precision, calculated risk, and the ability to extract maximum value from every operation.
entry.content:
Autor(es): discircle ®, Jhéssica Rinaldin, Cazė Grabıas, Gabo Torquato

Lemonade Global Ventures is an investment fund founded by experienced entrepreneurs, focused on scaling profitable businesses with proven revenue models. Its verbal and visual identity reflects a strategic, results-driven approach, combining commercial intelligence with the real-world experience of building and scaling companies. The brand symbol merges a lemon silhouette with a globe, representing the intersection of sharp business decisions and global expansion. Concepts such as Zero Sugar and Squeeze reinforce its positioning: no empty promises or easy formulas, just strategic precision, calculated risk, and the ability to extract maximum value from every operation.



Lemonade Global Ventures


EN
Lemonade Global Ventures is an investment core founded by high-caliber entrepreneurs, designed to accelerate the expansion of profitable operations with proven cash generation. Verbal and visual identity systems were developed in alignment with the fund’s strategic thesis—equipping the brand with the rigor required to negotiate with mature operations that are resistant to empty promises. In an environment dominated by theoretical "smart money" advice and superficial analyses, the brand breaks away from academic playbooks by delivering commercial intelligence forged in day-to-day business reality. It stands as an institutional framework grounded in the track record of those who built companies from scratch, negotiated nine-figure exits, and know firsthand the cost and effort of turning a sales model into a predictable revenue engine.

The brand’s foundation stems from the direct convergence of its name and market ambition: Lemonade meets Global. This premise materializes in the symbol by integrating the silhouette of a lemon with the structure of a terrestrial globe. Rather than resorting to a conventional sphere, the construction adopts a calculated elliptical profile, where longitudinal lines simultaneously represent citrus segments and earthly meridians. Moving beyond mere decorative graphics, the mark takes on practical weight: uniting the acidity required to navigate complex scenarios with the maturity to expand businesses on an international scale.

This dynamic unfolds into a verbal and visual system that approaches the corporate landscape without romanticism. Grounded in concepts such as Zero Sugar and Squeeze, the brand deconstructs the casual perception of the lemon into pure business discipline: growth demands sour decisions, an appetite for risk, and the clarity that enduring results are never built on easy formulas or sugarcoated promises. Across every touchpoint with the market, verbal and visual identities operate together to consolidate this stance—proving that solid businesses do not rely on shortcuts, but on the precision required to squeeze maximum value from the reality of every operation.


PT
A Lemonade Global Ventures é um núcleo de investimento fundado por empresários de alto calibre, criado para acelerar a expansão de operações lucrativas e com geração de caixa comprovada. Os sistemas de identidade verbal e visual foram desenvolvidos em sintonia com a tese estratégica do fundo — conferindo à marca o rigor necessário para negociar com operações maduras e refratárias a promessas vazias. Em um ambiente dominado por conselhos teóricos de "smart money" e análises superficiais, a marca rompe com as cartilhas acadêmicas ao oferecer inteligência comercial forjada na realidade diária dos negócios. É uma estrutura institucional fundamentada no histórico de quem construiu empresas do zero, negociou saídas de nove dígitos e sabe exatamente o custo e o esforço de transformar um modelo de vendas em uma máquina previsível de receita.

A fundamentação da marca nasce do encontro direto entre o nome e a ambição de mercado: Lemonade e Global. Essa premissa ganha forma no símbolo ao integrar a silhueta de um limão-siciliano à estrutura de um globo terrestre. Em vez de recorrer a uma esfera convencional, a construção assume um perfil elíptico calculado, no qual as linhas longitudinais representam simultaneamente os gomos da fruta e os meridianos da Terra. O desenho deixa de ser apenas um grafismo decorativo e passa a carregar um significado prático: a união entre a acidez necessária para navegar cenários complexos e a maturidade para expandir negócios em escala internacional.

Essa dinâmica desdobra-se em um sistema verbal e visual que encara o ambiente corporativo sem qualquer romantismo. Apoiada em conceitos como Zero Sugar e Squeeze, a marca desconstrói a leveza óbvia do limão para traduzi-la em pura disciplina de negócios: crescer envolve decisões azedas, apetite ao risco e a clareza de que resultados duradouros não se constroem com fórmulas fáceis ou promessas adocicadas. Em todos os pontos de contato com o mercado, as identidades verbal e visual operam juntas para consolidar essa postura — provando que negócios sólidos não dependem de atalhos, mas da precisão em espremer o valor máximo da realidade de cada operação.

entry.title: HANSSEM
entry.summary: Proyecto por Charry Jeon con 51 imágenes.
entry.content:
Autor(es): Charry Jeon, CFC, Jeong Moon Choi, Soomin Woo, Seoin Song, HYUNGSEOK LIM, Seyoun Kim


THE CHALLENGE
Founded in 1970, Hanssem has played a leading role in shaping Korea’s residential culture. In 2024, the company undertook its first corporate identity renewal in 32 years.

The goal of the renewal was to build a contemporary brand image that reflects evolving values and expectations while preserving the expertise and heritage Hanssem has established over 54 years. The project aimed to retain the iconic character of its red, yellow, and blue block symbol while improving its usability and versatility across various brand touchpoints, including digital platforms. It also sought to establish a cohesive identity system that brings its sub-brands together under a unified visual language.
-
1970년 창립 이래 국내 주거문화를 이끌어온 한샘은 2024년, 32년 만에 CI 리뉴얼을 진행했습니다. 
이번 리뉴얼의 목표는 한샘이 54년간 축적해 온 주거환경에 대한 전문성과 정통성을 이어가며, 변화하는 시대에 부합하는 현대적인 브랜드 이미지를 구축하는 것이었습니다. 빨강, 노랑, 파랑 블록으로 이루어진 심볼의 상징성을 계승하며 디지털 환경을 비롯한 다양한 브랜드 접점에서의 사용성과 확장성을 높이고, 하위 브랜드를 아우르는 일관된 아이덴티티 체계를 정립하는 것이 프로젝트의 목표였습니다. 

THE SOLUTION
CFC reinterpreted Hanssem’s iconic block symbol to create a simpler, clearer visual identity system. The brightness and saturation of the original primary colors were refined to enhance their vibrancy, while the number of blocks was reduced from nine to seven, improving the symbol’s versatility across applications.

The newly developed logotype draws on the geometric characteristics of the symbol, incorporating block-inspired forms into parts of the first letter H and the final letter M of “HANSSEM.” This creates a stronger visual connection between the symbol and logotype. With its bold, solid construction, the logotype extends across sub-brands and services, including Hanssem Rehaus and Hanssem Service, forming a unified identity system.

The blocks of the symbol extend into a graphic motif that runs throughout the visual identity. Flexibly adapted within a structured grid, the blocks serve as frames or dynamic graphic elements, conveying Hanssem’s expertise and vitality across various physical and digital brand touchpoints.

Following the CI renewal, CFC also developed brand identities for Hanssem’s premium kitchen brand, Kitchenbach, and sofa brand, MVME, each reflecting its distinct character. Kitchenbach expresses a refined and sophisticated aesthetic, while MVME establishes a youthful and playful brand image.
-
CFC는 한샘의 핵심 시각 자산인 블록 심볼을 재해석해, 보다 간결하고 선명한 비주얼 아이덴티티 시스템을 구축했습니다. 기존 삼원색의 명도와 채도를 조정해 색상의 선명도를 높이고, 9개로 구성된 블록을 7개로 단순화해 활용성을 개선했습니다.
새롭게 개발된 로고타입은 심볼의 조형적 특징을 반영한 형태로, ‘HANSSEM’의 첫 글자 H와 마지막 글자 M의 획 일부에 블록 형태를 도입해 심볼과의 시각적 연결성을 강화했습니다. 볼드하고 견고한 로고타입은 한샘리하우스, 한샘서비스 등 하위 서비스와 결합되어 통합적인 아이덴티티 체계를 형성합니다.
심볼의 블록은 비주얼 아이덴티티 전반을 관통하는 그래픽 모티프로 확장됩니다. 구조적인 그리드를 기반으로 유연하게 변주되는 블록은, 때로는 프레임으로, 때로는 역동적인 그래픽으로 활용되며 온·오프라인의 다양한 브랜드 접점에서 한샘이 지닌 전문성과 생동감을 전달합니다. CI 개발에 이어 진행된 한샘의 프리미엄 키친 브랜드 키친바흐와 소파 브랜드 MVME의 BI개발에서는 각 브랜드의 고유한 정체성을 시각화했습니다. 키친바흐는 정교하고 세련된 미학을, 소파브랜드 MVME 는 젊고 유쾌한 감각을 중심으로 차별화된 브랜드의 이미지를 구축했습니다.

entry.title: SPAZI IBRIDI NETWORK MILAN
entry.summary: Building the identity of an urban cultural network
entry.content:
Autor(es): Frakas Design

Building the identity of an urban cultural network

SPAZI IBRIDI NETWORK MILAN
2026 ART DIRECTION
Spazi Ibridi (Hybrid Spaces) Network Milan brings together independent sociocultural centres operating across the city. Created through the collaboration between the City of Milan and a network of local organisations, it promotes open, accessible and multifunctional spaces working across culture, social life, education and neighbourhood services.
The network connects a wide range of organisations: cultural centres, community spaces, educational venues and places dedicated to local care, cultural production and civic life. Some operate mainly at the neighbourhood scale, while others develop activities with a city-wide, national or international reach.
The project emerged from the need to make this distributed geography visible. A constellation of places that often escapes conventional maps, yet produces culture, services, relationships and forms of citizenship every day.
The platform is built around a device that allows users to explore the city through the spaces that inhabit it. The map and navigation tools reveal the extent of the network and the diversity of activities these places make possible: events, workshops, repair cafés, study rooms, sports, welfare services, community initiatives and cultural programmes.
One of the main challenges was developing a system capable of celebrating this diversity while allowing each organisation to preserve its own identity. The platform acts as a hub that connects and guides visitors while directing them to the spaces’ own channels, maintaining their autonomy and relationship with their communities.
To represent the hybrid and multifunctional nature of the network, we developed an identity based on a series of coloured building blocks. Each space becomes a totem composed of activities, services, values and cultural initiatives. An open system that reflects the complexity of the network without reducing places to a single function.
From a technical perspective, the website integrates a synchronisation system that automatically imports information and content from the spaces’ existing channels. This reduces the workload required to maintain the platform, avoids adding extra responsibilities to the organisations and keeps a direct connection with the people running the spaces.
The project developed over more than three years, accompanying the evolution of the network and the institutional changes affecting Milan’s sociocultural spaces. A long-term process based on listening, mediation and continuous adaptation.
Working on cultural and civic projects means engaging with complex organisations, multiple stakeholders and evolving decision-making processes. Our experience in the cultural sector allows us to support these projects with sensitivity, an understanding of social dynamics and the ability to build shared tools over time.

entry.title: DOLIVING apartment branding
entry.summary: Proyecto por ONNFF™ ART&DESIGN con 25 imágenes.
entry.content:
Autor(es): ONNFF™ ART&DESIGN

DOLIVING apartment Brand Identity Design

有度里公寓的品牌设计，从居所这一朴素命题展开。中文标识外嵌房屋轮廓，像边界，也像庇护，成为贯穿始终的图形表达。围绕这一核心，我们延伸出一套完整的品牌触点：室内标识与导视、手提袋、信封、单页，以及房子形状的盒子和杯子等日常物件。品牌因此不只停留在平面，而是进入居住者的行走、取用与停留之间。天蓝与草绿构成主色，一面呼应天空的开阔，一面呼应草地的自然，整体传达舒适、自由、轻松的居住状态。

The identity for DOLIVING Apartment begins with a simple idea: dwelling. A house outline frames the Chinese wordmark—at once a boundary and a shelter—and becomes the recurring graphic language of the brand. Around this core, a complete set of touchpoints was developed: interior signage and wayfinding, tote bags, envelopes, leaflets, as well as the house-shaped box and cup. The brand therefore moves beyond graphic surfaces and enters the daily paths of residents—walking, reaching, pausing. Sky blue and grass green form the primary palette, echoing the openness of the sky and the natural ease of a meadow. The overall character is comfortable, free, and relaxed.

entry.title: Faminto
entry.summary: Proyecto por Another Collective con 26 imágenes.
entry.content:
Autor(es): Another Collective




Before there were recipes, there was hunger. Before there were kitchens, there was fire. Faminto was born from that almost primal instinct: the meeting of meat and flame, in a place where everything is shaped by iron and fire.

This identity makes no attempt to tame that hunger. It embraces it through a bold, direct and no-frills visual language, built around one of our oldest relationships: the one between animal, fire and those who gather around it. At the heart of the visual system, an ancestral figure echoes the earliest images left on stone, like a mark carried through time.

Textures and organic forms extend this raw, instinctive world, while the typographic language brings structure and a more contemporary rhythm. The contrast between the irregularity of the graphic elements and the precision of the typography gives the identity a strong, distinctive presence without taking away what feels most spontaneous about Faminto.

Rather than reinventing what has always made sense, the identity takes the brand back to the essentials: fire, meat and the hunger that brings people to the table. It asks neither permission nor forgiveness. It arrives hungry and gets straight to the point.
